Affective impact showed no significant\nrelationships with the other outcomes.",
      "pdf_page": 9,
      "explanation": "“These effects” refers to the preceding claim about all three comparison components predicting elevated psychopathology. Adjusted longitudinal results were substantially narrower: affective impact was unrelated to most outcomes, and its PTSD association had the opposite direction and missed the preregistered significance threshold. Comparison discrepancy was excluded from the regression models. The blanket claim materially overstates persistence after adjustment."
